population: Every claimed config and every declared same-file auth_dbname pair in the original canonical corpus; currently one pauthz -> authdb pair in test/test.ini. No extractor output is consumed.
rules: Read original configs whole; never delete source definitions or move corpus members.
Native SHOW DATABASES/PEERS/USERS/CONFIG attests membership; source positions stay C.
Native reference probe disables the referenced database, then sends an unknown-user startup to the source database; native error must name that authentication database as disabled.
Negative control replaces only that auth_dbname value with a nondeclared name in a scratch copy; native log must report that name unconfigured. Refuse wildcard or nonunique controls.
All backend host/port values use a nonexistent local socket endpoint; no backend SQL, PostgreSQL server or Docker. Native admin commands and startup packets only.
Fail the entire native reference family on any missing pair, failed config, identity mismatch, or disagreement. No C fallback in A output.
